sourceOfTruth: The PR head code and GitHub Actions run reports, not this file alone.

globeIntegration.approach: New source-checked geographic reference pins for 196 countries, five oceans and 17 seas. Existing 161 city/place ID records and prices preserved. All 218 feature pins link to source-backed text.
globeIntegration.safeLimitations: Countries use approximate reference centre positions; oceans/seas manually selected reference points, not sovereignty boundaries. The app has not been tested on the user's actual browser or existing account.
unusualGeographies: TW and PF are explicitly outside the 196 country gateway archive, although their existing location pins remain supported.

photoIntegration.reader: Up to three verified CC images for an article, with visible named author, original Wikimedia file link and licence link.
photoIntegration.unlockedGlobe: Up to two verified CC images when the article country has a reviewed photo record.
photoIntegration.noPhotoCopyrightAssertionForExistingCode: Original app.js auto-searches Wikimedia photos without the same visible per-image attribution. That code is not modified and must be audited before release.
photoIntegration.limitations: Thirteen individually reviewed photo metadata records plus on-demand CC-checked Commons results. Automatic depiction accuracy and online image availability across every feature remain unverified. This does NOT mean 196 individually reviewed photographs.
photoIntegration.dynamicCommonsPhotoChecker: world-commons-media.js checks current Creative Commons file licence, author and trusted Wikimedia upload host before display; automatically found images include depiction warning and source/CC hyperlinks.

profileAndEconomy.currentStatus: Real production app.js now runs world-profile-preservation.js before startup; ensureProfile preserves historical XP/points, unknown purchased IDs and original profile backup; location buying detects alias families; shop and globe show three pairs once.
profileAndEconomy.criticalRisk: No known destructive migration reset remains in world PR2 app.js, but browser test against an actual user's account is not possible; realistic synthetic old profile migration regression and Chromium acceptance are used.
profileAndEconomy.requiredBeforeMerge: Reconcile PR #1 app.js changes, wire safeRulesModule into actual profile migration and buy/gallery/globe paths, back up user data, and run real old-profile tests and device tests.

publish: Draft branch. Require all relevant world safety, full marking and browser-acceptance tests green before release, then assess integration with unmerged exam PR #1. No end-user data modified by branch edits.
